messages:
Yara: Morning update 1 Avalon11b-int4 overnight suite finished. Ran focused long-doc recall + GTN slices. I computed a DeltaUnitScore for quick tradeoff calls.
Tom: Paste the topline please.
Yara: TL;DR then full numbers below. Short version: big cost win, localized recall regression on multi-hop docs. Recommend hybrid route with a small GTN holdback and 5% conservative GTN probe after priming fixes.
Yara: Full smoke metrics:
```
model: Avalon11b-int4
mean_cost_per_1k: $0.68
baseline (Avalon11b-fp16) cost_per_1k: $1.95
cost_reduction: 65.1%
overall_quality_delta: -1.05pp (chat-summary + intent)
recall_slice_delta: -3.9pp (multi-hop long-doc QA)
p95_latency_short: 210ms
p95_latency_long_cold: 360ms
DeltaUnitScore: 0.76   # 0..1, higher better; weighted(cost_savings:0.5, quality:0.4, latency:0.1)
```
Isha: 0.76 is attractive, but recall -3.9pp worries legal/regression-sensitive GTN. Any hallucination uptick?
Yara: Hallucination metric +0.3pp on the recall slice, faithfulness dip consistent with recall drop. No safety flags triggered in fuzz tests.
Ben: Ops notes: KV cache miss rate ~22% on long-doc runs. Cold batch sizes were small; GPU utilization ok. Adding warmstart reduces p95 by ~60ms in local repros.
Tom: Proposed rollout: create routing flag `avalon.int4.hybrid.v1` with default split 0.75 and holdbacks ["gtn_core","legal_search"]. Add emergency fallback to baseline if any holdback slice delta >1.2pp sustained 10m.
Isha: For GTN specifically: we'll not shift production GTN until micro-eval shows <1.0pp gap. But we can probe 5% of GTN with human-in-the-loop validation after priming tweaks.
Yara: Priming experiments planned: P1 longer context anchors, P2 explicit citation anchors, P3 warmstart + prefix caching. Will run each at 2k sample and post results.
Ben: I'll wire the routing flag and the infra fallback thresholds tonight. Name it `avalon.hybrid.canary.2026-03`.
Tom: Add an observability rule: if DeltaUnitScore drops <0.70 OR recall_slice_delta worsens by >1.5pp within 30m, auto-fallback.
Yara: I'll update the scorecard with the DeltaUnitScore formula and upload CSV. Quick note in PM thread: cost savings ~65% but recall hurt on multi-hop; recommended hybrid with holdbacks + priming + micro-eval before GTN shift.
bench-bot: bench-run completed: 6311112223 -> 6311112175. Long-doc KV miss rate 22%. Microbench artifacts uploaded to /bench/artifacts/6311112223.
Isha: Owners: Yara (priming experiments & scorecard), Ben (routing flag + infra fallback), Tom (PM comms + GTN probe plan). I'll coordinate human eval for GTN.
Tom: OK, I'll schedule a short sync with PMs and legal and post the A/B details.
Yara: Thanks all 1 will post priming results by EOD and a short decision matrix for PMs.
Tom: :thumbsup:
